prediction: #433 brief step 5 / nfs30plan1010 PLAN.md steps 1+2: HAKUX_TEXSCAN=1 and HAKUX_REPORT_ASYNC=1 together vs both off at the NFS MW race start. texscan removes the cube-face downloads (~7.3 ms/frame of synchronous finish + readback) but on its own moves that time into the #804 report fence (~10.5 ms/frame); the async report path takes that fence off the PFIFO thread, so with both on neither wait is on the pacing thread. Refuted if W or P fail with both '[texscan] on' and '[reportasync] on' logged: then a wait remains on the pacing thread in this configuration (the reader's gate at slot reuse, or the render thread's submit), which a HAKUX_REPORT_TRACE=1 run on the same build names (gate= and wait= fields). This pair decides texscan's default: PASS recommends both default-on together.
